requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

390-1486-4231-4875--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Conspiracy, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Hulking Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Conspiracy, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

4067-6478-7890.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Arbor Adherent with toughness 3 or greater.
4067-6478-7890.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.

3258-7417-7715.description:
If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Blink Sanar using The Mighty Thor. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
3258-7417-7715.notes: If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1308-3899-4552-7329.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2463-3259-4885.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2463-3259-4885.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

877-4284-6967.description:
Cast Clone by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Clone triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Clone.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1486-3457-7176.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Seeker of Skybreak to gain all creature types.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seeker of Skybreak ability, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2

2292-3755-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2292-3755-4871-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1168-1479-2841-6156.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1168-1479-2841-6156.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2653-5702-6441-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2653-5702-6441-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa each trigger twice.
Resolve the Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

1680-4508-5491-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Map and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1987-4131-4423-6650.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
You control three additional Islands.
1987-4131-4423-6650.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Basalt Monolith by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Basalt Monolith.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

225-1846-4222.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1846-4222.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat from step 2

1652-4030-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-4030-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2792-5003-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}.
2792-5003-5256.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Great Whale.
When Great Whale dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 2, causing target player to mill cards equal to Great Whale's power.
Repeat.
If the lands can tap to produce at least {5}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1976-3165-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
1976-3165-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

831-3307-5183.notablePrerequisites: The Archimandrite is your commander, does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
831-3307-5183.description:
Cast Delusions of Mediocrity by paying {3}{U}.
Delusions of Mediocrity enters the battlefield, causing you to gain 10 life.
When you gain life, The Archimandrite triggers, giving Advisors, Monks, and Artificers you control +10/+0 until end of turn.
Deal first strike combat damage to an opponent using The Archimandrite and gain an equal amount of life due to lifelink.
When you gain life, The Archimandrite triggers again, giving Advisors, Monks, and Artificers you control at least +10/+0 until end of turn.
Deal normal combat damage to the same opponent with The Archimandrite.
The opponent loses the game due to being dealt at least 21 damage by your commander.

2104-3198-4839.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Viashino Sandscout by paying {1}{R}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, putting it under Viashino Sandscout.
Lore Drakkis triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Viashino Sandscout triggers, returning itself and Lore Drakkis from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2517-2822-2936-3765.description:
Cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, returning Kediss and Bloodswarn Steward from exile to the battlefield.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Kediss.
The opponent dealt damage loses the game due to having less than zero life.
Kediss triggers, dealing damage equal to the combat damage dealt to each other opponent.
Each other opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.
